faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Not from Artemis. Your bank applies its own plan (virtual cards are included in most Qonto and Revolut Business plans; Stripe Issuing charges according to its own pricing).
faq.q2: What happens if I go over my quota?
faq.a2: On a paid plan, your agents keep going: each mandate beyond the quota is billed {price} at the end of the month. On Sandbox, requests are refused with the code quota_exceeded.
faq.a3: {base} per month, plus {client} per active client, meaning each client for whom at least one mandate was created during the month.
faq.q4: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a4: Yes, from the Billing area. The subscription runs until the end of the paid period; your data stays exportable.
